connection_providers.title: InterNIC portal login — the office signs in to portal.internic.co.il with this
connection_providers.title_he: כניסה לפורטל אינטרניק — הלשכה מתחברת עם זה ל-portal.internic.co.il
connection_providers.now: Type the InterNIC account ONCE, here: DOMAIN_INTERNIC_USER (the portal's user name or e-mail) and the password. The row declares the portal's address (app.url), so the office browser mirrors it into its own password store at every start and on `bbox b42 logins sync` (apps/browser42/logins.py); `bbox domain-internic login` then clicks the portal's user-name field and picks that saved login — the app itself never holds, prints or returns the password. When the portal asks for a code it sent by e-mail, the app reads that mail through the office's mail (DOMAIN_INTERNIC_MAIL_CONNECTION names the mailbox) and types the code. One attempt per call, never a retry: a registrar locks an account that guesses.
connection_providers.wizard: fill שם משתמש + סיסמה of the InterNIC portal once; then: bbox domain-internic login
